Ontario Student Accused of Spying for China in U.S. Investigation

An Ontario university student has been implicated in a United States spying investigation. The student is accused of taking photographs at an airport for a Chinese official. This development has led to confusion regarding Ontario's new high school attendance policy, with the education minister stating that principals will have the final say on student absences. The minister's comments have reportedly caused further uncertainty.
